text:
Olive Park: hey team! olive here, joining infra today. my one ask: are there any snack allergies i should know about? i'm planning to bring a welcome stash (gluten-free, maybe some spicy chips). :wave:
Lena (People Ops): welcome Olive!! no major allergies on the roster, but we have a peanut-free shelf label in the kitchen. pls drop anything with nuts in the marked bin. also we'll do a short intro lunch tomorrow at 12:30. :salad: :tada:
Carlos M.: welcome! i'm a chronic granola hoarder but allergic to strawberries. strongly endorse spicy chips. :hot_pepper:
Mina Patel: hey Olive 60a i'm team gluten-free yes. gluten-free cookies always win. also if you bring anything dairy-free label it.
Olive Park: noted. i'll mark everything clearly. quick poll: react with your fav snack type so i can pack right: :cookie: = cookies, :chips: = chips/crisps, :apple: = fruit, :pretzel: = pretzels/savory
Devon (IT): cookie for me but also fyi we have a mini fridge for hummus/vegan dips. plug-in near the microwave is a little finicky, let me know if you need an adapter.
Carlos M.: :cookie:
Mina Patel: :cookie:
Lena (People Ops): :apple: (trying to be healthy this week)
snack-bot: Poll results: 2 cookies, 1 apple, 0 chips, 0 pretzel.
Olive Park: nice! i'll bring two kinds of gluten-free cookies and a fruit box. also bringing a tiny stash of instant matcha for those mornings.
Mina Patel: you're a hero. :sparkles:
Devon (IT): heads up for badge swag: we sometimes hand out welcome stickers with your team logo. ping me if you want one.
Lena (People Ops): welcome packet + Slack channels shared. drop by my desk for a quick badge and building tour if you have 10 min.
Olive Park: thanks everyone. also random Q: is there a good desk plant to survive my neglect?
Mina Patel: snake plant or pothos. nearly impossible to kill.
Carlos M.: pothos is the office MVP.
Olive Park: perfect. thanks again, see you at lunch! :smile:
